description: A formal room with dark wood panelling and tall windows. Two men in the foreground, one in a military-style uniform with shoulder boards on the left and one in a dark high-collared tunic on the right, pass a sheet of paper across a dark table between two microphones. Behind them a crowd of men in suits, trench coats and some military uniforms with caps and medals watches. The table holds inkwells, pens and stacks of papers with no legible writing. Mid-twentieth-century dress and desk microphones; no visible text, frame or border.
